label: POLICY DESIGN
name: News Media Incentive (NMI) / News Bargaining Incentive

enactedChargeRate.note: Rate imposed by the News Media Bargaining Charge Act 2026

threshold.metric: relevant Australian digital advertising revenue for the financial year

offset.groupRule: new eligible expenditure in relation to at least 8 different news business corporate groups
offset.singleGroupRule: a parent entity may not use so much of a particular adjusted total as exceeds one quarter (25%) of the NMI amount payable

pathways.title: Qualifying news expenditure / commercial deals
pathways.description: Eligible expenditure supporting registered Australian news businesses can offset NMI liability.

pathways.title: NMI charge payment
pathways.description: Liability not offset through eligible expenditure is payable as charge and directed to the News Journalism Payment Scheme.
